exposure: claims-based algorithms for small for gestational age
claims-based algorithms for noncardiac congenital malformation
cohort: The study included 10,899 live-birth pregnancies from mothers who delivered between 2000 and 2010 within a single large healthcare system, linked to their claims in the Medicaid Analytic eXtract (MAX) database.
finding: The positive predictive values (PPVs) of the claims-based algorithms for identifying selected perinatal outcomes ranged between 74% and 92%, indicating varying but generally good accuracy.
